关键词: Results of Operations and Financial Condition
主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: NICK) reported its results for the three months ended December 31, 2015. The company announced that its diluted net earnings per share increased by 17% to $0.35, compared to $0.30 for the same period in 2014. Net earnings for the quarter were $2,727,000 in 2015, up from $3,769,000 in 2014. Revenue also rose by 4% to $22,757,000 in 2015, compared to $21,800,000 in 2014. The report was filed as a Form 8-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on January 28, 2016.
